links.outcome: MedQA accuracy with vs without knowledge-base retrieval augmentation
links.effect: Knowledge-base augmentation significantly reduced DeepSeek-R1 accuracy by 4.36% (p=0.0002); no significant benefit for the other models.
links.quote: Knowledge-base augmentation did not consistently improve performance; for DeepSeek-R1, it significantly reduced accuracy by 4.36% ( p=0.0002 ), while no significant benefit was observed for the other models.

unlisted_practices: Comparing locally deployed versus cloud-based model deployment modes on accuracy, latency, and connection reliability

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (knowledge-base augmentation) and local vs cloud deployment mode
screen.reason: The study benchmarks cloud vs. locally deployed LLMs on MedQA and explicitly evaluates the effect of knowledge-base augmentation (retrieval-augmented grounding) across models, measuring accuracy, latency, and reliability.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding added to an existing tool
